newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed prices rise on low volumes.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed prices rise on low volumes.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Monday rose by 3/4 rupees at 1,142/1,143 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative buying, dealers said.
"Volumes however remained at a low ebb due to poor attendance by dealers while prices looked up on the back of overseas enquiries," one dealer said.
Attendance in the market was poor due to a disruption in train services after opposition parties called a strike in Maharashtra state. But Bombay was spared from the strike.
Groundnut oil rose from 362/363 rupees per 10 kg to 365 rupees on rising prices at the producing centres coupled with limited inflow of 40/50 tonnes.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose by 10 rupees at 575 rupees per 15 kg.

In Bombay imported palm oil moved up to 259/260 rupees per 10 kg from 257 rupees on the back of recovery in the world prices which arrested fresh offerings by the local importers while absence of fresh arrivals at Bombay port and outstation buying helped local prices to bounce back after recent losses.
